title: Protein Concentration and Buffer Exchange Using Ultrafiltration for Phase Separation Studies
author: Jianxiong Chen
materials: Basal Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 2 mM DTT, 150 mM NaCl)
Stock Solutions PEG6000 stock: 20% and/or 50% (w/v) NaCl stock: 2 M Base buffer: 10 mM Tris-HCl, 2 mM DTT
DTT Stability DTT should be freshly added to buffers before use. Avoid long-term storage of DTT-containing buffers.

steps.title: Pre‑wet filter and initial spin
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL ultrapure water to the ultrafiltration device, incubate on ice for 2–5 min, then centrifuge at 14,000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL ultrapure water to the filter unit.

steps.title: Load protein and initial concentration
steps.instruction: Add up to 0.5 mL Ni‑NTA eluate to the pre‑wetted filter and centrifuge at 10,000–14,000 × g, 4 °C for 3–5 min.

substeps.instruction: Add up to 0.5 mL protein solution (Ni‑NTA elution) to the filter unit.

steps.title: Wash filter with basal buffer (3×)
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL low‑salt basal buffer, gently mix, and centrifuge at 10,000–14,000 × g, 4 °C for 3–5 min; repeat this wash three times to remove imidazole and adjust buffer composition.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL basal buffer, gently mix.
Repeat the add‑mix‑centrifuge cycle two more times (total three washes).

steps.title: Final concentration of protein
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter for 5–15 min until only ~50–80 µL remains in the retentate.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at the same speed (10,000–14,000 × g, 4 °C) for 5–15 min, monitoring volume until ~50–80 µL is left.

steps.title: Recover concentrated protein
steps.instruction: Invert the filter device into a clean collection tube, centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 2 min, and collect the concentrate.

substeps.instruction: Invert the filter unit into a clean tube.

steps.title: Measure protein concentration
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration immediately after recovery.

steps.title: Store protein aliquots
steps.instruction: Aliquot the protein as needed and store at –80 °C; avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare phase‑separation reaction
steps.instruction: In a 10 µL final volume, mix the protein with PEG6000 (0 %, 2 % or 5 %), NaCl (75–300 mM gradient), and basal buffer to achieve the desired final concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Add NaCl to reach 75–300 mM final concentration.
Add basal buffer to bring the total volume to 10 µL.

steps.title: Incubate reaction briefly
steps.instruction: Allow the mixture to sit at room temperature for a short period (brief incubation).

steps.title: Observe phase separation
steps.instruction: Examine the sample under a microscope to assess phase separation.
